name: ModelVariant464_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant464_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a 33-step band and two rings grow out of the slot towards a point 450 units in front of or behind it); for a non-negative request it takes the 0x3C-byte command row at data + 0x1C indexed by the request, gets the slot part, uploads five textures and builds the primitives, otherwise it projects the part and its target, draws the rings and, below phase 6, the band from the row's start time, and returns 4 in phases 2 to 4, 1 on entering phase 7 and 2 in phase 8; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the PAL header-481 and 631 images build it through french_model_variant/variant481_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH (palette x 640) and bind the data name 8 bytes higher. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
